objects.name: Detection technique coverage: check-elevated-cmd-using-whoami
objects.description: The following analytic identifies the execution of the "whoami" command with the "/group" flag, where the results are passed to the "find" command in order to look for a the string "12288". This string represents the SID of the group "Mandatory Label\High Mandatory Level" effectively checking if the current process is running as a "High" integrity process or with Administrator privileges.
